cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Market-price advisory (crop/livestock pricing, best time/place to sell) ties agricultural decisions directly to smallholder farmer income and credit decisions, not just agronomy Q&A.

test_prompts.prompt: My cassava leaves are turning yellow and curling, and I'm in southwest Nigeria during the rainy season. What could be causing this and what should I do?
I have 20 chickens and want to start a small poultry business with limited capital. What breed should I start with and what basic housing/feeding setup do I need?
